Nocturnal Wallet · Testing Guide

A guided walkthrough of the Nocturnal wallet

Five feature flows on Canton Network Devnet — from first sign-in to signing a swap — each step shown on-screen.

01Onboarding02Transfer03History04Connect & Swap05Elfa AI

Before you start

  • Pin the extension from the Chrome toolbar so Nocturnal stays visible.
  • Use the Devnet network throughout — it provides a faucet for free test Canton Coin and a block-explorer link on completed transfers, so every step runs without real funds.
  • Have a Google account ready — sign-in is via Google.
Switching network signs you out. Changing the network from the dashboard header clears your session and returns you to Unlock/Welcome. Pick Devnet before onboarding so you don't have to unlock again.
01Feature

User Onboarding

Onboarding opens in a full browser tab (the popup closes if it loses focus). The happy path runs Welcome → Google sign-in → Create Password → Save Private Key → Acknowledgment → Confirm → Dashboard.

1.1

Welcome

Choose your network — set it to Devnet — then click Sign in with Google.

1.2

Sign in with Google

A new tab opens the Google flow. Choose your account and approve the requested access (name, profile picture, email). You're returned to the wallet to set a password.

1.3

Create Password

This password encrypts your private key on your device. It must satisfy every listed rule, and both fields must match, before Continue enables.

1.4

Save your private key

A new key pair is generated. Save this key securely — it is the only way to recover your wallet. Switch Base64 / Hex, Reveal to view, and Copy to save it, then click I've Saved My Key.

1.5

Security Acknowledgment

Check all three boxes to confirm you're responsible for your key, then Continue.

1.6

Confirm

Type the phrase exactly — “I accept full responsibility for my wallet keys and backups.” — then Complete Setup to land on the dashboard.

1.7

Unlock (returning users)

When the wallet locks, you'll see Wallet Locked. Enter your password and Unlock. Use Sign in with a different account to switch Google accounts.

The wallet auto-locks after a period of inactivity, returning you to the Unlock screen.
02Feature

Transfer Canton Coin

The dashboard's bottom bar holds Wallet · Send · Offers · History · Insights. The header shows your email and your party ID (with a copy button) — the address others send to.

2.1

Wallet & balances

The Wallet tab lists your tokens. A fresh account shows Canton Coin at a balance of 0; after funding, each token shows its balance.

No pre-approval step needed. A transfer pre-approval is registered for you automatically during onboarding, so you can receive Canton Coin right away — you should not see any “Register Transfer Pre-Approval” banner.
2.2

Get test funds (Faucet, Devnet)

Tap the Canton Coin row to open Token Details. On Devnet this screen includes a Faucet card — enter an amount, your password, and Request … CC. Refresh after a few seconds to see the balance update.

2.3

Send a transfer

On the Send tab, pick CC — Canton Coin, paste the Recipient Party ID, enter an Amount (MAX sends everything available), then Continue.

Confirm & sign

Review the summary and the Estimated fee breakdown (wallet fee, network fee, total — lines and amounts vary with network conditions). Keep enough balance to cover the amount plus fees. Enter your Password to sign, then Sign & Send.

Sent

Transfer Sent confirms the send and offers View on Explorer, which opens the Lighthouse block explorer with the transaction's full details.

03Feature

Transaction History

The History tab lists each transfer with its amount and token, a status badge, the timestamp, and the sender → receiver parties. Transfers received via the automatic pre-approval show as AUTO APPROVED.

Other states (no screenshot): a brand-new account shows “No history”; history pages 5 entries at a time, with Prev / Next once you exceed 5; and the Offers tab holds Incoming/Outgoing offers for token-standard (non–Canton Coin) transfers, which you can Approve, Reject, or Withdraw. Canton Coin transfers settle directly and don't create offers.
04Feature

Connect a dApp & Swap on Kairo

Kairo is a Canton DEX — a separate web app that connects to Nocturnal for approvals and signing. There's no swap screen inside the wallet; a swap surfaces in Nocturnal as approval popups.

Unlock Nocturnal first. The dApp approval popups have no password field — they sign using your already-unlocked session. If the wallet is locked, the request fails.
4.1

Open Kairo and connect

On the Kairo DEX, click Connect Canton Wallet. Kairo detects installed wallets and lists Nocturnal among the options — select it.

4.2

Approve the connection

Nocturnal opens a Connect Request showing the site's origin (e.g. https://devnet.kairo.ag) — click Approve. Kairo then asks you to sign a sign-in message; Nocturnal shows a Sign Message Request with its contents (“Sign-in to Kairo DEX”) — Approve again.

Connected

Kairo now shows your connected account and the exchange interface.

4.3

Perform a swap

In Kairo's Exchange, choose From and To tokens (e.g. $CC → $CBTC), enter an amount, and Review Swap. Confirm on Kairo; it shows Swap in Progress and waits for you to sign.

Approve & settle

Nocturnal opens an Execute Transaction Request with the swap's parameters. Review and Approve to sign and submit. Afterward, your Nocturnal balances reflect the trade (Canton Coin down, Canton Bitcoin up).

05Feature

Elfa AI Insights

The Insights tab has four sub-tabs — Tokens · Narratives · Search · Chat — with a 24h / 7d window toggle on the data tabs. The footer reads “Powered by Elfa”.

Tokens (trending)

The default view ranks tokens by social mentions, with a change % and a mindshare bar; a pinned Canton Coin card shows its price. Tap a token for its top mentions, then expand a mention for account credibility (smart followers, reach, engagement).

Narratives & Search

Narratives groups trending clusters; expand Show sources for the @handle sources. Search queries social mentions for any token or keyword, with quick chips (Canton, CC, cBTC, cETH, SPCX) and per-row credibility.

Chat (AI market chat)

Ask Elfa about the market. From the empty state, type a question (e.g. “Give me today's market insight”) and send — a Thinking… placeholder shows while it responds, then the reply renders with formatting. New chat (top-right) clears the conversation.
